finding: We tested whether limiting every realized coverage loss removes a storage lottery’s expected regret advantage. At the optimal fixed-storage loss limit, 54 of 420 problems retain an advantage over unrestricted deterministic cue policies, while 93 become worse. Relaxing the limit halfway toward one restores all 174 improving problems. Independent rational reconstruction and both full replays verify this constructed-method tradeoff; forecast accuracy and process correspondence remain unestablished.
